items.name: tilt-card

items.name: base-accordion
items.title: Base Accordion
items.description: An animated accordion component built on Base UI with spring physics, height collapse mask gradient, blur transitions, and gliding layoutId focus ring.

agentMetadata.intent: Expand and collapse related content sections inline.
a11yConstraints: Keep each trigger keyboard accessible and associated with its panel.
agentMetadata.motionEngine: Motion layout-height morphing with spring chevron transitions.
compositionRules: Use one AccordionItem per independently discoverable section.

items.name: base-alert-dialog
items.title: Base Alert Dialog
items.description: An accessible alert dialog built on Base UI with smooth Motion 3D perspective entrance and exit animations, customizable sizes, and media slots.

agentMetadata.intent: Require explicit confirmation before an irreversible action.
a11yConstraints: Preserve focus trapping and always provide a cancel action.
agentMetadata.motionEngine: Motion perspective spring entrance with backdrop presence transition.
compositionRules: Use AlertDialogTrigger render for the initiating control.
compositionRecipes: Compose with base/button for destructive confirmation.

items.name: base-button
items.title: Base Button
items.description: An interactive button component built on Base UI with Motion hover/tap scaling and shadcn/ui variants.

agentMetadata.intent: Trigger an immediate user action with clear visual and motion feedback.
a11yConstraints: Preserve native button keyboard activation and disabled semantics.
agentMetadata.motionEngine: Motion spring scale on hover and tap with reduced-motion bypass.
compositionRules: Use as a trigger for dialogs, menus, and form submission.
compositionRecipes: Compose with base/dialog for modal actions.

items.name: base-checkbox
items.title: Base Checkbox
items.description: An accessible, stylable checkbox built on Base UI with a Motion-friendly animated indicator.

a11yConstraints: Preserve the checkbox role, label association, and keyboard toggling.
agentMetadata.motionEngine: Motion checkmark and elastic scale feedback.
compositionRules: Pair with a visible label and optional description.
compositionRecipes: Compose with base/button in a settings form.

items.name: base-context-menu
items.title: Base Context Menu
items.description: An accessible context menu built on Base UI with smooth Motion spring scale and submenu slide animations.

agentMetadata.intent: Offer contextual actions for a target using pointer or long-press interaction.
a11yConstraints: Keep essential actions available through a non-contextual path.
agentMetadata.motionEngine: Motion scale and opacity presence with directional submenu transitions.
compositionRules: Use ContextMenuTrigger around the contextual target.
compositionRecipes: Compose with base/alert-dialog for destructive actions.

items.name: base-dialog
items.title: Base Dialog
items.description: An accessible modal dialog built on Base UI with smooth Motion spring entrance and exit animations.

agentMetadata.intent: Present focused modal content that temporarily interrupts the current task.
a11yConstraints: Keep focus trapped and provide DialogTitle and DialogDescription.
agentMetadata.motionEngine: Motion scale, perspective, and backdrop blur presence transition.
compositionRules: Use DialogTrigger render with a semantic interactive trigger.
compositionRecipes: Compose with base/button for confirmation actions.

items.name: base-dropdown-menu
items.title: Base Dropdown Menu
items.description: An accessible dropdown menu built on Base UI with smooth Motion spring scale and submenu slide animations.

agentMetadata.intent: Present a compact list of actions or choices from an anchored trigger.
a11yConstraints: Preserve roving focus, keyboard navigation, and Escape dismissal.
agentMetadata.motionEngine: Motion scale and opacity presence with collision-aware submenu cascades.
compositionRules: Use a semantic button as the trigger.
compositionRecipes: Compose with base/button for account actions.

items.name: base-switch
items.title: Base Switch
items.description: An accessible, highly customizable switch built on Base UI with Motion spring layout physics.

agentMetadata.intent: Toggle a binary on/off setting or preference.
a11yConstraints: Preserve the switch role, label association, and keyboard toggling via Space or Enter.
agentMetadata.motionEngine: Motion layout spring physics with stiffness: 500, damping: 30.
compositionRules: Pair with a visible label and optional description.
Provide clear visual contrast between checked and unchecked states.
compositionRecipes: Compose with base/button in a settings form.

items.name: base-tooltip
items.title: Base Tooltip
items.description: An accessible tooltip built on Base UI with spring-based keyframe scale and translation animations powered by Motion.

agentMetadata.intent: Provide contextual hint or shortcut explanation when hovering or focusing an interactive element.
a11yConstraints: Render accessible name/description without trapping keyboard focus.
Dismiss cleanly on Escape without activating underlying element.
agentMetadata.motionEngine: Motion spring scale, directional translation offset, and presence transition.
compositionRules: Wrap interactive elements with TooltipTrigger using render prop or semantic button.
compositionRecipes: Compose with base/button for icon-only action button descriptions.
